hardware.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark
hardware.note: torch.cuda.get_arch_list() on this part returns sm_80/90/100/110/120 -- nothing is built for 12.1. That gap is the point of this arena.

upstream.note: upstream ggml-org master; the fork carries 5 commits on top of it (laguna arch port + DFlash draft). The arch port is upstreamed as ggml-org/llama.cpp#25595, unmerged at pin time. 'What changed vs stock' = these 5 commits plus your diff.

editablePathsNote: CUDA kernels and the model graph. Deliberately NOT editable: tools/server (the thing being measured), common/, tests/, and the CMake build definition -- a submission that changes how it is timed is not a submission.

gates.rule: git diff vendor base->candidate touches only editablePaths, and the target's model integrity (file sha256 + param count from /props) is unchanged.
For every public prompt: candidate output is byte-identical to the target's golden, at batch 1, greedy, warmup discarded.
Same, on prompts the submitter has never seen. Run by the referee only. Catches a kernel that reassociated its way into a different argmax everywhere except the prompts it was tuned against.
decode_speedup >= 0.95 AND prefill_speedup >= 0.95. Hard floors -- you cannot trade prefill away for decode.
score > current leaderboard score for every target claimed.

scoring.pairing: Speedups are paired ratios: baseline and candidate arms run back to back, alternating, in the same session on the same node. The ratio cancels host and thermal drift -- which is not theoretical here (a published baseline failed to reproduce a day later, 24.05 -> 20.09 tok/s).

measurement.warmupNote: The first request after server start differs on BOTH engines. Discard it or every comparison reports a phantom mismatch.

determinism.vllm: 12/12 identical (0.26.0) at batch 1; n=2 -> 2 distinct, n=6 -> 5 distinct
determinism.consequence: Any batching breaks token identity, so the ranked track is serial. This is not a limitation to route around; it is what makes the cheap correctness gate possible at all.

thermalGate.note: mlxfast uses a fixed 40 C. The Spark idles around 43 C (measured 43 on Spark-1, 2026-07-28) and has been observed at 84 C under sustained load while its sibling idled at 43, so 40 is unreachable and copying it would deadlock the gate.

policy.optimizationVsRecipe: Optimizations preserve output and get the cheap gate. Changes that alter output (precision, quantization, sampling) are a new RECIPE, not an arena submission, and need eval evidence on howtospark.com.
policy.scoreScope: A submission names the targets it claims. Engine-general changes score across all targets; model-specific ones score on one. A claim of 'faster Q4_K MoE matmul' where a dense Q8_0 target also moves is incoherent and does not promote.
policy.baselineAfterPromotion: OPEN QUESTION -- mlxfast re-pins the baseline to the frontier. Until decided, the baseline is the vendor pin above and every score is only meaningful against contractVersion 1.
